articles.title: Anthropic says it’s committing 5% of its shares to a ‘public benefit fund’
articles.summary: Anthropic said that it will commit 5% of its shares to the fund.

articles.title: Disney agrees to hire the majority of Character.AI’s workforce
articles.summary: The filing also says that the “vast majority” of Character.AI employees who were offered jobs at Disney accepted them. However, this is a stalking horse bid, so another company could come forward with a higher offer.

articles.title: Replit makes OpenAI its default over Anthropic, CEO says
articles.summary: Over the weekend, Masad clarified that OpenAI would replace Anthropic as its default model provider. Claude will still be available to customers on the platform.
